0022600130.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-3, 5th in the Pacific, 3 games back, 15th in the West) visit the San Antonio Spurs (1-2, 3rd in the Southwest, 2 games back, 9th in the West) in the Kings' fourth game of the season, with Sacramento on a three-game losing streak. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The teams have not played yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Kings lost all three meetings, most recently 132-104 in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
